fusions.name: Coiled Lunge
fusions.desc: Strikes from a coil, dealing 7 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and making the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Hissing Cloud
fusions.desc: Hisses a cloud ahead of you, dealing 26 damage to everything in the cone that ignores resistances. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Venomed Patience
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds. An escort of chicks fights beside you for 15 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Burn
fusions.desc: When a condition you inflicted runs its course, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
